༄༅/ /phyag rdor rdo rje gtum po'i gza' klu sde brgyad kyi dug sbyong khrus chog gdon 'grol gyi lag len chu 'bab tu bkod pa bdud rtsi'i snying

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// phyag rdor rdo rje gtum po'i gza' klu sde brgyad kyi dug sbyong khrus chog gdon 'grol gyi lag len chu 'bab tu bkod pa bdud rtsi'i snying po bzhugs so//

khyod mtshan nyin mor byed pa'i 'od brgya pas// gdengs can mun pa'i dug khams mthar byas nas// phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i mchog sbyin mkhan// gang der phyag byas bdud rtsi'i snying po spel// phyag rdor rdo rje gtum po'i gza' klu'i dug sbyong gi lag len la/ thog mar stegs bu'i steng bum gdan padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i khar bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan dung chos gzungs thag dang ldan pa'i nang du bum rdzas kri ya dang mthun par blug /de'i mdun du gsang bdag gi 'das gtor zlum po mtheb kyu bzhis bskor ba bzhag /mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sbreng tshar du bsham/ stegs bu de'i mdun du dar dkar po'i khar lcags dang rag sogs min pa'i rdza'am zangs dmar gyi snod du zan gyi/ klu gzugs stod lha'i rnam pa sbrul mgo dgu'i gdengs ka can smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ gza' gzugs stod srin po khros pa'i gzugs can bya rog gi mgrin pa yan chad spyi bo nas thon pa gdong gcig pa lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas dmad cing bdug pa/ de so so'i mthar klu bshos zlum po brgyad/ gza' bshos g.yon gcus brgyad/ ril bu brgyad re/ changs bu brgyad re sogs dang*/ rgyas par klu nor dang klu sman/ gza'i mthun rdzas yab la sha khrag gi mtheb kyu dang yum la klu sman ril bu sogs kyang bkod/ de la gdong phyogs par yon bdag gi bsgres glud dri mas sbags pa'ang dkor nor yas rdzas sna tshogs bcas bkod/ klu gza'i gzugs dang sku glud gnyis kyi mtha' skor du klu gza' la phog thug mi yong ba'i rin chen sman 'bru zas dar gos chen sogs kyis bskor zhing klu sman yang btab/ de dang nye bar zangs dmar lta bu'i gtor snod du klu bshos rgyab yol ma ting lo mtheb kyu changs bu dang bcas pa dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman gyis brgyan pa dang*/ gza' bshos gru gsum dmar po g.yon gcus/

'khor rang 'dra brgyad dang phyogs bzhir zlum po bzhi'i mtha' skor du yab la sha khrag gi mtheb kyu dang yum la klu sman ril bu dang gza'i mthun rdzas kyis brgyan pa bzhag /slob dpon rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nas ze/ khrus dar dang byab rdzas kyi rma bya'i mdongs/ shing sna'i phon po/ sa rdog /chu/ rlung g.yab/ me sgron/ me long dang bcas bzhag pa rnams bca' gzhi'i rim pa yin no// las gzhung bsrang tshul la rgyas pa'i skabs ni bdag bum gnyis ka tshig gcig gis sgom bzlas byed pas las byang gtum po rang gi gnam lcags 'od kyi drwa bar bkod pa nas rdzogs par gyer ba'i bstod pa'i mjug tu/ 1$0000270oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa:1$0000300 ces pa bdag bskyed la dmigs nas brgya stong sogs bzlas/ de nas gzungs thag la 'jus nas bum par sngags gong ma brgya tsam dang 1$0000270oṃ e ho shuddhe 1$0000300 sogs khrus bdun gyi gzungs kyang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla/ de nas tshogs byin brlab lhag gtor yan btang la/ skabs 'dir klu gza'i gzugs la dgug bstim glud bsngo sogs dug sbyong yongs rdzogs tshar nas yas rnams phyir bskyal tshar ba'i rjes su las byang gi mjug chog rnams byed/ cho ga 'di ltar na gong gi gshom gyi skabs su yang sman rag dang chad brtan gtor ma bgegs gtor tshogs sogs kyang bsham dgos shing 'di ltar byed kyi lag khrid tsam ma gtogs/ da lta lag len bstar chags su byed pa'i tshul ni/ bcas rnams legs par bshams tshar ba'i rjes su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs zhing phyag rdor dmigs nas skyabs sems spyi ltar dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// zhes sogs kyi yan lag brgyad pa bya/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim/ mchod rdzas rnams raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor bkrus/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar mchod pa rnams nam mkha' gang bar spel

la/ arghaṃ sogs brjod/ de nas/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo chen pos bar mtshams med par khyab pa'i dbus su/ padma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khar gza' brgyad klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du rang gi rig pa hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag gtum zhing khros pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku lus sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ yan lag rags pa/ khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra gyen du 'khyil zhing me stag gi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis dug sbrul thugs kar bzung ba'i mgo bo zhal du gsol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan sogs dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang seng ge'i gong slag dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs shing me dpung 'bar zhing 'khyil ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor khyung mthing ga /dpung pa g.yas su khyung dkar po/ dpung pa g.yon du khyung ser po/ pus mo g.yas su khyung dmar po/ pus mo g.yon du khyung ljang gu rnams gnam lcags kyi mchu sder can me'i gshog pa g.yab cing rdeb pa rnams gsal bar bsgoms la bdag nyid kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs par bsam la/ spyan 'dren pa ni rdor dril dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: klu rgyal dbang sdud gnyen po ye shes lha: thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: klu bdud sbrul 'dzin rdo rje rgyal thabs can: rdo rje rtse bran 'bum brgyan khro bo'i rje: rdo rje klu 'joms nag po gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes spyan drang*/ hūm̐: klu gnyan padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje bzhugs su gsol: 'khor lo padma lnga yi gdan steng du: mkha' lding bya khyung klu 'dul bzhugs su gsol: badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍaḥs ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: zhes rang dang gnyis su med par bsam/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍaḥs pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje can gyi sku: mthing nag 'jigs pa rdo rje'i gar stabs can: gdug pa'i klu 'dul bya khyung rigs lngas mtshan: gnyen por gyur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod pa bya/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ de'i mthar/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas bskor bar dmigs nas spro bsdu'i dmigs pa rgya chen po dang bcas nas sngags brgya stong ci nus su bzla ba ni bdag bskyed yin no// de nas bum bskyed ni/ dregs 'dul nang sgrub kyi las tshogs bum pa'i cho ga las/ rin po che yi bum pa'i nang: chu gtsang sman sna tshogs tshad blug: kha rgyan mgul chings rgyan rnams bkod: ces pa'i bshams tshul gong du song nas/ bum bskyed ni/ de nas bum pa bskyed bya ste: swa bhā wa yis stong par sbyang:

bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: de dbus hūm̐ las gtum po bskyed: ye shes sems dpa' dgug cing bstim: zhes gsungs pas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa/ phyi bum pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gnas pa'i dbus su padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khar gza' brgyad klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po las/ zhes pa nas bstod pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bum pa'i las tshogs las/ snying kha'i sa bon sngags kyis bskor: bdag nyid thugs ka'i sa bon las: 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas: bum pa'i lha yi thugs kar thim: bum pa'i lha las 'od 'phros pas: bde gshegs mchod nas 'od tshur 'dus: bum pa'i nang du khro chung dang: khyung dang ye shes bdud rtsir bsam: zhes pa'i don bzhin dmigs pa'i spro bsdu dang bcas nas gzungs thag la 'jus nas rtsa sngags/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe: yaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: khaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: e yaṃ raṃ khaṃ laṃ shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: zhes khrus bdun gyi sngags nyer gcig sogs bzlas pa byas la/ las tshogs las/ thun mtshams mchod bstod gtor ma bsngo: zhes pas gong du bshams pa'i gsang bdag gi 'das gtor raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ rtsa sngags la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa bdun nam gsum gyis phul bas/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i 'od kyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsam la phrin las gang dgos bcol/ bum lhar dung chos kyi mchod yon phul la bum lha 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsir bsam mo// de nas klu gza'i gzugs bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/

klu la/ phuḥlas gnod byed kyi dregs pa klu de nyid stod lha'i lus la sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa klu brgyad gnyan dgu sogs so so'i gzugs kyi rnam pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ gza' la/ triḥlas gnod byed kyi dregs pa gza' rā hu la stod srin po khros pa'i lus can gdong gcig gi steng bya rog gi dbu mgrin pa yan chad spyi bo nas thon pa/ lus kun mig gis gang zhing 'jigs pa'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'khor gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi dang rgyu skar nyer brgyad so so'i gzugs kyi rnam pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ gnyis ka la/ sdong zla sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par gsal bar gyur/ de nas rang phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas gnod byed kyi gtso bo klu dang gza' yi sde tshogs rnams rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs brnyan la thim par bsam/ rdor dril 'dzin pas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bka'= khyad par du yang gsang sngags dang rig sngags thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i mthus/ zhes bden stobs sngon du 'gro bas/ gnod byed dregs pa gza' klu sde brgyad sdong zla sna 'dren rgyab rten 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis bstim/ de nas glud gzugs gtor ma dang bcas pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las glud gzugs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba 'dod yon 'dzad pa med pa'i longs spyod kyi dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas par bsam la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/

sambha ra tshar bdun se gol dang bcas pas mgron rnams la bsngos pas mnyes shing tshims nas gdug sems zhi bar bsam la/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// zhes chos sbyin yang bya'o// de nas gdon 'grol dug sbyong bya ba dngos ni/ gang la byed rgyu'i nad pa de bos la de'i mdun du ras kyi khar klu dang gza'i gzugs nad pa la kha phyogs pa dang*/ glud kyang klu gza'i gzugs la gdong bstan nas sgrig /nad pa'i rkang pa dang glud kyi bar dri lam dar ras nag po 'am skud pa nag pos sbrel la/ dang po phrin las bcol ba ni/ 'di ltar bya/ slob dpon gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la sprul pa'i khro rgyal bcus bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs tshur byon rdo rje 'chang: shar gyi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal: sku mdog dkar po 'gying bag can: phyag na rang rtags rdo rje gsor: khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs phyir du: gdon rnams ma lus bsrung ba dang: byad rnams ma lus 'grol ba dang: dug rnams ma lus phyung ba dang: nad rnams ma lus phan byed cing: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed: sku mdog ser po bzhad tshul can: phyag na rang rtags rin chen 'dzin: khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs phyir du: gdon rnams ma lus bsrung ba dang: byad rnams ma lus 'grol ba dang: dug rnams ma lus phyung ba dang: nad rnams ma lus phan byed cing: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo chen po rta mchog dpal:

sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phro: phyag na rang rtags padma 'dzin: khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs phyir du: gdon rnams ma lus bsrung ba dang: byad rnams ma lus 'grol ba dang: dug rnams ma lus phyung ba dang: nad rnams ma lus phan byed cing: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil: sku mdog ljang gu gtum la rngam: phyag na rang rtags ral gri bsnams: khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs phyir du: gdon rnams ma lus bsrung ba dang: byad rnams ma lus 'grol ba dang: dug rnams ma lus phyung ba dang: nad rnams ma lus phan byed cing: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hūm̐: steng 'og mtshams kyi phyogs skyong drug: dbyug sngon me dbyug mthing*/ mi g.yo ral zhags ljang*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal: bhanda rnga yab ljang*/ rnam rgyal 'khor lo be con dkar/ hūm̐ kār rdor thod mthing*/ stobs po che: lcags kyu dung dmar dud kha/ rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan bsnams: rnal 'byor phrin las bcol ba ni: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs phyir du: gdon rnams ma lus bsrung ba dang: byad rnams ma lus 'grol ba dang: dug rnams ma lus phyung ba dang: nad rnams ma lus phan byed cing: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod:

ces pa'i bar song nas/ 1$0000270gnyis pa bkru ba ni/ 1$0000300de ltar khro bo rnams spyan drangs shing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing sel ba'i phrin las mdzad cing*/ slob dpon gsang ba'i bdag po'i phyag gi bum pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun nar gyis babs pas/ khyed rang gi lus la gnas pa'i gnod byed kyi dug rlangs ngan pa'i byad gdon thams cad sbal sbrul sdom sdig rta bla la sogs te srog chags kyi rnam par/ sbur ma rlung gis ded pa ltar dri lam nas brgyud nas gdon gzugs la thim zhing*/ nad thams cad kyang rnag khrag la sogs pa'i rnam par dri lam las brgyud de glud la thim par mos pa nad pa dang slob dpon gnyis kas byas la bum chus bkru zhing khrus gsol ba ni 'di skad do// hūm̐: bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog: byed pa sems can kun don byed: phyi ni bum pa'i rnam pa la: nang ni gsang bdag chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu yi lus bkrus pas: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe: yaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: khaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: e yaṃ raṃ khaṃ laṃ shuddhe shuddhe nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bum pa shel bum dri med zlum: me long ye shes chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu yi lus bkrus pas: zhe sdang de las bshos pa yi: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs 'gre / bum pa gser bum dri med zlum: mnyam nyid ye shes chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu yi lus bkrus pas: nga rgyal de las bshos pa yi: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs/ bum pa padma rā ga'i nang: sor rtog ye shes chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu yi lus bkrus pas: 'dod chags de las bshos pa yi:

nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs/ bum pa ind+ra nī la zlum: bya grub ye shes chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu yi lus bkrus pas: phrag dog de las bshos pa yi: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs/ bum pa mthing kha dri med zlum: chos dbyings ye shes chus yis bkang: skal ldan bu yis lus bkrus pas: gti mug de las bshos pa yi: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs/ bum pa rin chen gzhal yas khang: pha rol phyin drug chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu yis lus bkrus pas: rgyud drug bag chags rten byed cing: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bkru 'o// 1$0000270gsum pa byab pa ni/ 1$0000300slob dpon gyi lag g.yas su rdo rje dang rma bya'i mdongs thogs pa'i/ mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ yig mthing ga 'od zer 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon thams cad sbur ma rlung gis ded pa ltar nag nyil gyi phyags pa dri lam nas brgyud nas gdon gzugs dang glud la thim par bsam zhing byab/ hūm̐: gangs ri dkar po'i shar phyogs nas: rje rigs klu yi tshogs rnams dang: phur bu shing gza' nyid yin te: rengs shing 'khum pa'i nad gtong bas: gdug rtsub thams cad phyir phyungs shig: mthong ba'i dug rnams phyir phyungs shig: reg pa'i dug rnams phyir phyungs shig: kha rlangs dug rnams phyir= bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dug rnams phyir= do nub dug rnams mi phyung na: do nub byad 'di mi 'grol na: do nub mi 'di mi gtong na: do nub nad 'dir mi phan na: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' byung bas: khyod rnams srog snying gcod par byed: de bas bka' las ma 'da' bar: gdug rtsub thams cad phyir phyungs shig: mthong ba'i dug rnams phyir=
